thread:
maya (Support): Hey team — NovaHealth reporting intermittent 504s on /v1/embeddings when they batch 200 items in one request. Started ~09:10 UTC. They see partial billing charges. Ticket #23571.
andre (Support): Got logs from them. They say requests hang for ~30s then gateway returns 504. SDK retry loop then sometimes 502s. snippet: `POST /v1/embeddings batch_size=200 model=text-embed-002`
maya (Support): Can we get an initial triage? any recent infra changes in embeddings path?
liam (SRE): No infra deploys around that time. I see increased queue growth on ingress for embed-workers-usw2 at 09:09-09:15. p95 queue_time jumped to 18s.
sophia (eng-runtime): Notes: embeddings path hits KV cache locks during large batch KVCACHE lookups; if many concurrent large batches, we serialize on a mutex per-tenant shard. Could cause head-of-line delays.
andre (Support): Customer says they send 3 concurrent workers, each sending batch=200. Their usage pattern spiked.
maya (Support): Repro attempted with their payload? I ran a local sim with our SDK and hit a 504 after ~20s with 3x200 concurrent.
liam (SRE): Sharing brief logs:
```
[09:12:04] ingress: conn_id=abc123 recv=start
[09:12:05] embed-worker: batch=200 lock_wait=15000ms
[09:12:25] ingress: timeout -> gateway 504
```
liam (SRE): Looks like lock_wait correlates with 504.
sophia (eng-runtime): Agree. Hypothesis: KVCACHE per-shard mutex causing sequential processing under large batch pressure. Two possible fixes: 1) short-term: increase gateway timeout and throttle per-tenant concurrent batches; 2) longer term: make KVCACHE reads lock-free for lookups or sharded per-request parallelism.
maya (Support): What's the temporary mitigation we can propose to NovaHealth now? they need immediate relief.
sophia (eng-runtime): Immediate: ask them to reduce batch_size to <=50 or set concurrency to 1 while we patch. Also we can add a routing rule to send their tenant to a less-loaded pool. I'll open an internal rollout for a small config change to increase `ingress.gateway_timeout` from 20s -> 45s for their tenant.
liam (SRE): I can apply a per-tenant rate limit override to cap concurrent embed requests to 4 across their API keys. That should reduce lock contention.
maya (Support): I'll message the customer with: 1) temporary throttling/timeout change, 2) recommended batch_size<=50, 3) we're investigating a runtime fix. 
andre (Support): Customer update draft:
"We're seeing contention on internal cache lookups that can cause large batch requests to time out. We've temporarily increased your timeout and enabled concurrency caps. For immediate reliability please reduce batch size to <=50 while we implement a runtime fix."
maya (Support): Escalating to eng-runtime for a patch. @sophia can you estimate ETA for a lock-free read change or quick fix? 
sophia (eng-runtime): Quick patch: change KVCACHE mutex to reader-preferring rwlock to reduce read stalls — I can have a canary in ~6 hours, full rollout in ~18-24 hours if tests pass. Longer solution requires rework of cache API ~2-3 weeks.
liam (SRE): I'll watch metrics and revert per-tenant override once traffic stabilizes. Setting alert on queue_time > 10s for embed-workers-usw2.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ingress-override/6143219876 for tenant=novahealth scheduled.
maya (Support): Customer notified. Ticket updated. Will follow up after canary.
andre (Support): Adding note about billing: we will waive anomalous charges during the incident. Finance informed.
liam (SRE): FYI, started the per-tenant override now. Observability: queue_time p95 dropped to 4s immediately.
maya (Support): Great — marking as in-progress. Will post another update after canary and final patch.
